title: Socket watchdog constants: 15 s ping, 60 s silence, 30 s back-off cap (row 6 gap G-06-1)
reference_behaviour: The price socket pings every 15 s, reconnects after 60 s of silence, backs off to at most 30 s with a random spread, and retries every 5 s while offline (bundle-findings 6.1).
ours: Row 6 marks the feed stale after 3 s without a price frame with a 30 s reconnect window; REQ-114 AC-1 to AC-3 (row 11, being built) copy the watchdog.
